product_one_liner.value: Marquee uses AI to unify football data and deliver club-specific insights for professional clubs’ recruitment, squad planning and tactical analysis.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes unifying internal and external football data into club-specific insights, with professional clubs using it for recruitment, squad planning and analytics. Sources: https://themarquee.ai/about and https://themarquee.ai/

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer directs visitors to product, about, FAQ, news and a demo, with no pricing link. The pricing URL did not return a readable pricing page. Source: https://themarquee.ai/

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Reading FC’s Head of AI describes staff using Marquee, while Lanús’s Chief Scout describes its operational benefits. These establish actual product use rather than merely investor or data-provider relationships. Sources: https://themarquee.ai/ and https://themarquee.ai/news/club-atletico-lanus-partnership | named_customers.0: Reading FC’s Head of AI describes its staff using Marquee for reports and analysis. Source: https://themarquee.ai/ | named_customers.1: Lanús’s Chief Scout describes using Marquee to cover more scouting ground in less time. Source: https://themarquee.ai/news/club-atletico-lanus-partnership

employee_band.notes: The reported employee count is 19, which maps to the required 11-20 band. The reporting date is not supplied, so confidence is limited. Source: https://tracxn.com

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s LinkedIn profile explicitly identifies New York as its headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/themarqueeai | hq_country: The company profile identifies headquarters in New York and its location as US. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/themarqueeai

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile states 2025, corroborated by its Preqin profile. These outweigh a conflicting secondary record. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/themarqueeai and https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/marquee/790728

eng_blog.notes: The news index contains product articles, partnerships, press and events; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. It therefore does not meet the requested engineering-blog threshold. Source: https://themarquee.ai/news

public_docs.notes: The public navigation/footer links to a single FAQ page, but not a documentation site, help center or developer portal. This meets the requested negative criterion. Source: https://themarquee.ai/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Senior AI Scientist posting has an active application option and was updated November 3, 2026. Source: https://devjobs.co.il/job-details/4484676507

model_provider.value: Marquee’s own 12 proprietary AI/ML models, including transformers and graph neural networks.
model_provider.notes: The product page states that Marquee uses 12 proprietary AI/ML models; its technical product article identifies transformers and graph neural networks. This identifies its publicly described proprietary models, not an unverified external model vendor. Sources: https://themarquee.ai/product and https://themarquee.ai/news/build-or-buy

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Marquee’s own footer explicitly claims SOC 2. No additional certification is included without an explicit claim. Source: https://themarquee.ai/about | compliance_certs.0: Marquee explicitly claims SOC 2 in its own footer. Source: https://themarquee.ai/about

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both funding reports explicitly identify the July 2026 USD 4 million round as seed funding. Sources: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/marquee/790728 and https://www.finsmes.com/2026/08/marquee-raises-4m-in-seed-funding.html | funding_date: The latest USD 4 million seed round is explicitly dated July 2026, giving 2026-07. Source: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/marquee/790728 | funding_amount_usd: The latest round is reported as USD 4 million in seed funding. The company’s $6.5 million headline refers to cumulative funding, not the size of this round. Sources: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/marquee/790728 and https://www.finsmes.com/2026/08/marquee-raises-4m-in-seed-funding.html

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 seed financing falls within the eighteen-month window. Marquee’s dated announcement independently confirms funding activity on July 30, 2026. Sources: https://www.preqin.com/data/profile/asset/marquee/790728 and https://themarquee.ai/news/marquee-raises-6-5-million-seed

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The reviewed company job board shows only a Senior AI Scientist opening and no qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive title. Coverage is limited to the visible board. Source: https://www.devjobs.co.il/company-details/marquee-1

launched_6mo.notes: The July 14, 2026 announcement introduced access to SkillCorner Physical and Game Intelligence data through Marquee, a substantive new data integration within the six-month window. Source: https://themarquee.ai/news/skillcorner-partnership

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jonathan Hazut’s profile dates the start of his Marquee Co-Founder & CTO role to January 2026, within the requested twelve-month window. Marquee’s current team page also identifies him as CTO. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/jonathan-hazut and https://themarquee.ai/about

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable company jobs page lists its Senior AI Scientist opening but names no CRM, sales or marketing system. The empty list means no qualifying system was visible in the reviewed hiring material, not that none is used internally. Source: https://www.devjobs.co.il/company-details/marquee-1
